🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*  
• *Source/Speaker:* President Donald J. Trump (U.S. President)  
• *Announcement:* The U.S. announced removal of the extra 25 % tariff on Indian imports and a framework for an interim U.S.–India trade agreement that will deepen market‑access commitments.  
• *Market Stance:* 🟢 BULLISH  

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH (85 % — Official White‑House statement and signed Executive Order)  

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*  
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Metals / Auto, Textiles, Infrastructure, OGCs, Paints  
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* IT, Pharma, EMS, Chemicals, Aviation, Renewable Energy  
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Inflows  

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Favor a bullish stance on Indian equities, especially export‑oriented and tariff‑sensitive sectors; consider overweighting Metals/Auto, Textiles and Infrastructure while maintaining exposure to IT and Pharma for broader upside.
